referenceSelection: 2013-01 through 2025-12, fixed before viewing regional outcomes: a conservative post-startup fallback record ending in the last elapsed calendar year. Missing observations remain missing.
acquisitionDecision: Copernicus C3S v6.0 was preferred. After local configuration was updated, the authenticated January 2013 request succeeded, returning a 177,604,652-byte global file. This exceeds the prespecified 96 MiB feasibility cap, and the documented interface offers no regional subsetting. The approved Q56 NOAA VIIRS fallback is retained, with its shorter historical interval disclosed. No Copernicus or VIIRS records are spliced.

sources.title: Suomi-NPP VIIRS monthly chlorophyll-a
sources.licence: Provider: These data may be redistributed and used without restriction.
sources.processing: Native 0.0375 degree grid, source valid range and quality masking, native MUR ocean mask mapped by nearest coordinate, cosine-latitude weighted geometric regional mean of positive concentrations.
sources.limitations: Single-instrument fallback is shorter than the preferred C3S record. Satellite chlorophyll is a near-surface optical estimate, not total phytoplankton biomass. Cloud/mask changes and unspecified processing version may affect comparability.

sources.title: NASA JPL MUR v4.1-derived monthly SST
sources.producer: NASA JPL (daily foundation analysis); NOAA ERD (monthly composite)
sources.licence: NOAA mirror permits free use and redistribution, without warranty.
sources.processing: 0.1 degree spatial sample of native 0.01 degree product, open-sea mask and positive nobs; cosine-latitude weighted arithmetic mean in degrees Celsius. Six native-resolution month/region checks passed the predefined 0.05 degree C tolerance.
sources.limitations: Blended foundation-temperature analysis, not one instrument's direct measurement. Spatial sampling may introduce errors beyond the six checked cases.

sources.title: NASA MODIS Aqua R2022 monthly chlorophyll-a verification
sources.producer: NASA GSFC Ocean Biology Processing Group
sources.licence: NASA Earth science data openly shared without restriction; cite the producer and product.
sources.processing: Exact NASA monthly granule from public NOAA R2022 mirror, checked against NASA granule size and checksum when supplied; strict regional crop and area-weighted positive log-space average. Kept separate from VIIRS observations and all fitted trend series.
sources.limitations: One independent source month establishes a traceable NASA-data use, not validation of trend agreement. Algorithms and masks differ.

nasaResourceEvidence.claim: The application actually uses monthly NASA chlorophyll observations from a product supported by the challenge-listed Giovanni portal. This provenance evidence does not guarantee a judging eligibility decision.

verification.note: One authentic NASA MODIS Aqua monthly record is used as a separate source verification. Different algorithms and masks can produce different concentrations; one month does not verify trend agreement.

spatialValidation.method: Every tenth native latitude/longitude coordinate, 0.1 degree spacing; area weighted
spatialValidation.limitation: Six native-grid checks bound observed sample differences only; they do not guarantee every month's spatial sampling error.

limitations: Regional rectangles are predefined reference areas; they do not by themselves isolate an ocean process or establish causation.
HAC confidence intervals and p-values are approximate. Lag sensitivity is reported rather than selecting favorable settings.
Custom windows are exploratory; choosing many windows can produce chance significance.
Missing months and low-coverage observations are never imputed. Coverage reports sampled ocean area for SST and native-grid ocean area for chlorophyll.
The packaged historical record is frozen. No authenticated browser requests or unvalidated live significance are offered.
